title: Joomla Extension - valorapps.com - Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Easy File Uploader < 2.9.7 - An…
description: An unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability exists in the Joomla Extension Easy File Uploader versions prior to 2.9.7. An attacker can upload a PHP-executable file to the Joomla web root using a single multipart POST request without requiring credentials or a CSRF token.
